items.html: Behold, it has been well explained how the milk and the whiteness of ZA is drawn from the drop of the male, and the blood and the milk, which is the redness within him, is drawn from the drops of the female. And this is the secret of "to Me, milk and blood shall be offered" — for milk and blood are offered to the Most High, for all of ZA is built from the two of them, and they are offered to the Most High.
